item.title: Canfield students talk to astronauts live from space
item.description: The International Space Station passed over the Valley Monday afternoon, giving 500 students at Canfield's Hilltop Elementary School the chance to talk to a real astronaut -- live from space.

item.title: FBI says it's unaware of Savannah Guthrie talking with her mom's suspected kidnappers
item.description: Savannah Guthrie said her family is at their “hour of desperation” in the search for their apparently kidnapped mother, but made no mention of possible ransom in a new video released Monday just hours before a ransom deadline.

item.title: West Side bar manager cited, pleads no contest, to illegal liquor sales
item.description: Officers who went inside noticed several liquor bottles and workers taking payments for liquor even though the business does not have a liquor permit, reports said.

item.title: Local concert coordinator awarded $874K in default judgment
item.description: A Liberty Township concert coordinator was just awarded a $874,921 default judgment in a lawsuit where she says a promoter out of Atlanta, Georgia, bilked her out of hundreds of thousands of dollars and potential ticket sales.

item.title: Youngstown road closed amid water main break
item.description: Mariner Avenue in Youngstown is closed right now as crews are responding to a water main break.

item.title: Mahoning County sales tax up for renewal
item.description: Mahoning County Engineer Pat Ginnetti spoke at this evening's Boardman Trustees meeting, explaining why 0.25% sales tax to pave township roads should be renewed in May.
